items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Walter Page had the band, the Blue Devils. ... I used to go to Detroit and what have you when they had Edwards

ctx.x: I see. Who else was in that band?

Well, I'll tell you what had happened. Walter Page had the greatest band that I ever heard in my life. Now remember, I was running around, Milt. I used to go to Detroit and what have you when they had Edwards

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: we sent Big'Un home for a rest... he went home to take care of his family

ctx.x: That was the first Freddie Greene you got.

That's where you get Freddie Greene 'cause Freddie's out here, 'cause when he joined the band Walter Page said, no, it don't go like that. He had to change his whole - but Freddie was fortunate because Freddie started on banjo. Then he met Charlie and he was going to go and Charlie said, no, I'll sit up there with you. I used to sit up there with them, with two guitars, snare drum, and a sock cymbal, at the hotel - this is later. Then Big'Un said, no, it don't go like that.

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who brought Basie - Walter Page? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: the first one to leave the band, right? Jimmie, to go to Bennie Moten, and then he brought Basie in.
